text: Domino's Pizza, Inc. is a US franchisor listed on NASDAQ: per its fiscal-2025 Form 10-K, it is primarily a franchisor with approximately 99% of Domino's global stores owned and operated by independent franchisees as of 28 December 2025; internationally it generally grants geographical rights to the brand to master franchisees.

source.name: Domino's Pizza, Inc.: Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 28, 2025
source.quote: We are primarily a franchisor, with approximately 99% of Domino’s global stores owned and operated by our independent franchisees as of December 28, 2025.
source.note: Same 10-K, International franchise segment: 'In our international markets, we generally grant geographical rights to the Domino’s Pizza ® brand to master franchisees.' The 10-K does not name the Portuguese master franchisee.
